title: Kinesiology and Exercise Science, AAS-T

Academic Programs and Pathways

Degrees and Certificates

Kinesiology and Exercise Science, AAS-T

Kinesiology and Exercise Science, AAS-T

The Associate of Applied Science-Transfer (AAS-T) degree in Kinesiology and Exercise Science provides an in-depth, applied education designed to prepare students for rewarding careers in the health and fitness field. This program lays a strong foundation in the study of human movement and the physiological responses to exercise, equipping students with the necessary knowledge and skills for a variety of professional roles such as athletic trainer, fitness specialist, health promotion specialist, and many more. Graduates can pursue employment in health and fitness positions or transfer to degree programs. Students wishing to transfer should discuss this program with academic advisors.

Program Catalog Page

          Featured Faculty

          View Health & PE Staff Page

Amy Swanson

Health & Physical Education Full-Time Faculty

Professor Amy Swanson, MPH, is a graduate of Pacific Lutheran University with a BS in Exercise Science and Wellness. She strives to use her real-life experiences to enhance her classroom teaching. Having been in the field for many years, Professor Swanson aims to make daily connections to what students are interested in or passionate about. She is committed to teaching and guiding professional, hardworking, and quality fitness instructors so they may enter the field and change lives. 

                See Ann Swanson's full bio

Mark Yoshino

Health & Physical Education Full-Time Faculty

Mark Yoshino is a Senior Associate Professor and one of the longest-tenured employees at Bellevue College as he has been part of the institution for nearly 30 years. Mark has been the BC baseball coach since 1999. He is also the former chair of the NWAC Executive Board; the governing body for all community college student-athletes in the Pacific Northwest. He is the only person in the NWAC to win the conference’s top honor as a student-athlete (1989), coach (2007, 2009, 2011), and administrator (2013).

                See Mark Yoshino's full bio

Hadise Khaniyan

Health & Physical Education Full-Time Faculty

Dr. Hadise Khaniyan is currently a full-time, Assistant Professor at Bellevue College. She has been working as a researcher and an instructor in the health promotion field since 2009. Dr. Khaniyan believes each person has a unique greatness and unlimited potential locked inside themselves. It is her life’s mission to help those she works with believe in this potential and unleash it on the world. It is very important for her to provide a classroom environment where students are encouraged to express their own ideas and participate in their educational experience.  

                See Hadise Khaniyan's full bio

Michelle McRae

Health & Physical Education Faculty Member

Michelle McRae is a Lead Fitness Technician and an Adjunct PE Faculty member for the Fitness Center at Bellevue College. After completing BC’s Personal Fitness Trainer Certificate program and becoming a NASM Certified Personal Trainer, she enjoyed the program and people of Bellevue College so much she stayed on as staff and an instructor for the PE Life Fitness courses. Now, she finds tremendous satisfaction supporting BC students in finding fitness activities that they enjoy and that enhance their personal pursuits.

                See Michelle McRae's full bio

Health Sciences

Outdoor Recreation Leadership Certificate of Completion

Certificate

Explore the great outdoors and take your leadership skills to new heights. This certificate is designed to prepare you for a diverse range of personal and professional opportunities in the recreation, outdoor leadership, and education fields. You’ll learn both in the classroom and with field-based experiential education in the beautiful Pacific Northwest Cascades. The program will equip you with the skills and knowledge necessary to become a confident and effective leader in a variety of outdoor settings.

Health Sciences

Personal Fitness Trainer Certificate of Accomplishment

Certificate

Explore a career that offers flexibility and the chance to work with people. Personal fitness trainers fulfill roles in a variety of settings including fitness club technician, coach, and community center instruction. This certificate prepares you for the National Strength and Conditioning Association Personal Fitness Trainer Exam and other certifications. Students may apply certificate credits to an associate of arts and science transfer degree and continue their education with a four-year sports medicine or exercise science program.

Health Sciences

Yoga Instructor Certificate of Completion

Certificate

Yoga has been ranked as one of the top fitness trends in the United States for several years, and millions of Americans regularly practice yoga. This certificate can equip you with the knowledge and skills needed to teach yoga in a wide variety of health and wellness settings, both individually and in groups. It meets the National Yoga Alliance’s rigorous standards for 200-hour Registered Yoga Teacher certification. You’ll be a highly sought-after candidate for employment in the health industry.
